pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Vizard's free plan includes 60 credits per month. Creator starts at $29/month, while the advertised price with yearly billing is about $14.50/month… Business starts at $39/month (or approximately $19.50/month with yearly billing)"

sources.title: Pricing - Choose the perfect plan for you

nl.tagline: Clips uit lange video's met AI, met eigen branding
nl.description: Vizard knipt automatisch korte clips uit lange video's, voegt ondertitels toe en past je huisstijl toe. Een alternatief voor OpusClip, met een credit-model op basis van geüploade minuten.
bestFor: Podcasts en webinars omzetten in clips
Teams die branding consistent willen houden
limitations: Verbruik op basis van geüploade minuten

en.tagline: AI clips from long videos, with your branding
en.description: Vizard automatically cuts short clips from long videos, adds captions and applies your branding. An alternative to OpusClip with a credit model based on uploaded minutes.
bestFor: Turning podcasts and webinars into clips
notFor: People who prefer fully manual editing
limitations: Usage is based on uploaded minutes
